key: blues brothers, the (1991)(titus)[cr qtx]/Blues Brothers, The (1991)(Titus)[cr QTX].adf:benny:0:0000
name: run_depacker_decode_loop
description: Program entry point of the depacker: initialises the bit reader state and runs the decode loop, which reads bits from the packed stream through helper routines and writes to the background colour register.

name: halt_unimplemented_path
description: Stores a constant in a state word, then halts on an unimplemented path.

name: stub_no_decodable_body
description: The decompiler found no function body here, so the listed register accesses cannot be attributed to executable code; the routine is effectively a stub.

name: interleave_source_rows_into_output
description: Copies data from three source areas into an interleaved output buffer in four-byte groups, advancing each source pointer as it goes.

name: interleave_word_rows_from_sources
description: Fills an output buffer by interleaving words taken from three source streams, for a count given by a byte in the input, and stores that count in the output header.

name: init_six_table_entries
description: Sets the two words of each of six table entries to sixteen and stores two base pointers in shared state.

name: advance_pointer_return_byte
description: Advances a shared pointer by three and returns one byte of its argument.

name: advance_pointer_by_three
description: Advances a shared pointer by three and returns.

name: copy_fifteen_words_to_table
description: Copies fifteen consecutive words from an argument array into a table at one of two base addresses, chosen by whether a flag is set.

name: store_word_in_indexed_table
description: Stores a word from an argument into a table slot selected by a shifted index value.

name: set_copper_list_start
description: Stores the start address for the display copper list in two state words, then returns the register values unchanged.

name: store_copper_list_address
description: Stores the high and low halves of an address into a copper list pointer and records the value in shared state.

name: set_state_addresses
description: Stores a few fixed address values into shared state words.

name: reset_blitter_masks_and_wait
description: Sets the blitter mask and size registers to all-ones and a fixed size, waits until the blitter is idle, then stores a routine pointer.

name: poll_fire_button_and_update
description: Polls the fire button input and, depending on its state, updates audio channel volumes, a sprite pointer and blitter size, returning early when the button state is unchanged.

name: set_interrupt_flag_when_zero
description: When a state word is zero, stores a fixed bit mask that sets an interrupt request flag; otherwise it leaves the word unchanged.

name: wait_until_flag_clear
description: Busy-waits until a shared word becomes zero, then returns.

name: init_device_record_defaults
description: Initialises a device record: sets a self-reference, clears two fields, sets two fields to all-ones and a few defaults, and calls a helper in one branch.

name: clear_six_blocks_and_record
description: Clears six consecutive blocks of 1024 words each and records the start of each block in a table.

name: loop_forever_without_return
description: Loops forever and never returns.

name: read_next_queued_byte
description: Returns the next byte from a small ring of queued bytes, clearing its slot and advancing the read index unless it has caught up with the write index, and sets an interrupt-enable mask.

name: acknowledge_pending_interrupt_bits
description: Checks interrupt request bits and, when they are set, acknowledges them through a helper and clears the state, then sets the interrupt enable mask.

name: queue_byte_in_ring_buffer
description: Stores a byte in a small ring buffer, advancing the write index unless the buffer is full, and sets a flag entry for the byte.

name: update_input_state_machine
description: Compares the previous and current input state bytes and updates a small state flag when the button bits change, reporting the transition.

name: read_mouse_port_movement
description: Reads mouse port movement and the right and middle button bits, updating a previous-state byte and a movement delta.

name: clear_state_and_install_handler
description: Clears a 128-byte state block, sets a few registers to fixed values and installs a handler routine pointer.

name: clip_coordinates_to_screen
description: Compares two coordinate pairs against the 320-pixel-wide screen bounds, swapping and clamping values so they stay in range, and returns a flag.

name: step_table_with_interrupt_wait
description: Advances a pointer and a count, storing values into a table while waiting on an interrupt request bit before moving to the next entry.

name: return_second_argument_after_call
description: Calls one routine and returns the second argument unchanged.

name: store_string_length_and_pointers
description: Measures a string, stores its length and pointers into shared state, then runs a sequence of helper calls.

name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing: it returns immediately without changing any state or calling another routine.

name: copy_track_block_from_table
description: Divides a value by eleven, uses the quotient to select a table entry, copies a block of 128 words from it into a destination, then calls helpers for the disk transfer length.

name: decode_raw_track_sectors
description: Processes raw track data in a loop, looking up each sector's entry and calling helpers to decode it.

name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing: it returns immediately without changing any state or calling another routine.

name: pulse_control_bit_with_delay
description: Sets bit one, clears bit zero, then sets bit zero of a control byte, and busy-waits a fixed count before returning.

name: clear_control_bits_with_delay
description: Clears bits one and zero of a control byte, sets bit zero, then busy-waits the same fixed count before returning.

name: call_two_helper_routines
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: setup_disk_sync_transfer
description: Returns the shared word unchanged when a check passes; otherwise it waits for a disk activity bit to clear, then writes a sync word and transfer settings into the disk registers.

name: read_disk_sync_and_transfer
description: Reads a byte from the parallel port while a disk activity bit is set, then writes the sync word and transfer settings into the disk registers.

name: encode_mfm_bits
description: Spreads bits from a source byte into alternate bit positions of an output byte, combining them with a second byte, the kind of step used in disk data encoding.

name: find_sync_words_in_track
description: Scans raw track words for the disk sync word, counting matches across a set of sectors and calling helpers to decode each sector found.

name: advance_track_sector_scan
description: Counts down a sector counter and, while it is not finished, scans for the next sync word; when it finishes it resets the scanning state and calls helpers.

name: scan_forward_for_sync_word
description: Scans forward through raw track words until the disk sync word is found, then counts sectors and calls helpers.

name: skip_sync_words_in_track
description: Scans track words from a fixed offset for the disk sync word, skips any consecutive sync words, then decodes the data that follows.
